name: Vimpel Source
description: Read JSC Vimpel's public orbit data from HttpResponses: osculating J2000 elements as attributed epoch states ($OEM), rectangular ephemerides ($OEM), and the datefirst crosswalk of Vimpel and NORAD numbers as candidate links ($OIL); each batch's IngestRequest says what was read. Retrieval, the login and storage belong to the SDN host flow.

methods.displayName: Convert Vimpel osculating elements to epoch states

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse hostcap/http-request answers: BODY one JSC Vimpel orbit table of osculating elements as the public site serves it (comma-separated rows of 15 columns, up to 20,000 rows, bounded to 8 MiB). HTTP 200 parses; 304 gives the FlowNotice on unchanged and nothing else; any other status or a transport error refuses the call.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse hostcap/http-request answers: BODY one JSC Vimpel orbit table of osculating elements as the public site serves it (comma-separated rows of 15 columns, up to 20,000 rows, bounded to 8 MiB). HTTP 200 parses; 304 gives the FlowNotice on unchanged and nothing else; any other status or a transport error refuses the call.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One canonical $OEM per object: a single J2000 state at the table's reference epoch (UTC), named vimpel:<id>, with Vimpel's catalog namespace and exact id.

outputPorts.description: One canonical $OEM per object: a single J2000 state at the table's reference epoch (UTC), named vimpel:<id>, with Vimpel's catalog namespace and exact id.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The batch's IngestRequest: SCHEMA OEM.fbs, SOURCE_NAME vimpel, BATCH_ID and SOURCE_SHA256 the SHA-256 of the body, the response's URL, status and time; PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTES kind, records, bytes, muKm3PerS2, frame, timeSystem, columns (the column names), then object.<n> per object in table order: its eight columns as printed (nativeId, epoch, first observation, days since update, area/mass, magnitude, the two 50 % scalars), comma-joined.

outputPorts.description: The batch's IngestRequest: SCHEMA OEM.fbs, SOURCE_NAME vimpel, BATCH_ID and SOURCE_SHA256 the SHA-256 of the body, the response's URL, status and time; PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTES kind, records, bytes, muKm3PerS2, frame, timeSystem, columns (the column names), then object.<n> per object in table order: its eight columns as printed (nativeId, epoch, first observation, days since update, area/mass, magnitude, the two 50 % scalars), comma-joined.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One FlowNotice (kind Unchanged, SCHEMA OEM.fbs, REASON not-modified, ITEMS the URL) when the response is HTTP 304; nothing else is emitted then.

outputPorts.description: One FlowNotice (kind Unchanged, SCHEMA OEM.fbs, REASON not-modified, ITEMS the URL) when the response is HTTP 304; nothing else is emitted then.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse hostcap/http-request answers: BODY one Vimpel rectangular ephemeris (rows of an index, x, y, z in km, J2000, 600 s apart, 5 to 4,096 rows, bounded to 4 MiB); the URL's last segment (query dropped) is the file name <native id>_<YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>, the native object and the UTC epoch of the first row. HTTP 200 parses; 304 gives the FlowNotice on unchanged and nothing else; any other status or a transport error refuses the call.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse hostcap/http-request answers: BODY one Vimpel rectangular ephemeris (rows of an index, x, y, z in km, J2000, 600 s apart, 5 to 4,096 rows, bounded to 4 MiB); the URL's last segment (query dropped) is the file name <native id>_<YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>, the native object and the UTC epoch of the first row. HTTP 200 parses; 304 gives the FlowNotice on unchanged and nothing else; any other status or a transport error refuses the call.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One canonical $OEM: position-only J2000 samples 600 s apart from the epoch in the file name (UTC), STATE_VECTOR_SIZE 3.

outputPorts.description: One canonical $OEM: position-only J2000 samples 600 s apart from the epoch in the file name (UTC), STATE_VECTOR_SIZE 3.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The batch's IngestRequest: SCHEMA OEM.fbs, SOURCE_NAME vimpel, BATCH_ID and SOURCE_SHA256 the SHA-256 of the body, the response's URL, status and time; PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTES kind, fileName, nativeId, epoch, samples, stepSeconds, bytes, frame, timeSystem.

outputPorts.description: The batch's IngestRequest: SCHEMA OEM.fbs, SOURCE_NAME vimpel, BATCH_ID and SOURCE_SHA256 the SHA-256 of the body, the response's URL, status and time; PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTES kind, fileName, nativeId, epoch, samples, stepSeconds, bytes, frame, timeSystem.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One FlowNotice (kind Unchanged, SCHEMA OEM.fbs, REASON not-modified, ITEMS the URL) when the response is HTTP 304; nothing else is emitted then.

outputPorts.description: One FlowNotice (kind Unchanged, SCHEMA OEM.fbs, REASON not-modified, ITEMS the URL) when the response is HTTP 304; nothing else is emitted then.

methods.displayName: Read the Vimpel datefirst crosswalk as candidate links

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse hostcap/http-request answers: BODY the datefirst file: the header `Nvym t_det_v Nnor t_det_n`, then a Vimpel number, its first-detection date (YYYYMMDD), a NORAD number and its first-detection date per row. HTTP 200 parses; 304 gives the FlowNotice on unchanged and nothing else; any other status or a transport error refuses the call.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse hostcap/http-request answers: BODY the datefirst file: the header `Nvym t_det_v Nnor t_det_n`, then a Vimpel number, its first-detection date (YYYYMMDD), a NORAD number and its first-detection date per row. HTTP 200 parses; 304 gives the FlowNotice on unchanged and nothing else; any other status or a transport error refuses the call.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One $OIL: candidate links (STATUS Candidate) from Vimpel numbers (LEFT, namespace vimpel) to NORAD numbers (RIGHT, namespace NORAD), each with its evidence (SOURCE datefirst, RECORD_ID the edition's SHA-256, the line of its first declaration, the declarations and whether their dates differ), the ambiguous ones marked and the conflicts listed with their shape; identity evidence for the $CAT integrator, never an assertion.

outputPorts.description: One $OIL: candidate links (STATUS Candidate) from Vimpel numbers (LEFT, namespace vimpel) to NORAD numbers (RIGHT, namespace NORAD), each with its evidence (SOURCE datefirst, RECORD_ID the edition's SHA-256, the line of its first declaration, the declarations and whether their dates differ), the ambiguous ones marked and the conflicts listed with their shape; identity evidence for the $CAT integrator, never an assertion.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One FlowNotice (kind Unchanged, SCHEMA OIL.fbs, REASON not-modified, ITEMS the URL) when the response is HTTP 304; nothing else is emitted then.

outputPorts.description: One FlowNotice (kind Unchanged, SCHEMA OIL.fbs, REASON not-modified, ITEMS the URL) when the response is HTTP 304; nothing else is emitted then.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method reads one complete bounded provider file in input order and writes canonical records and one control frame; the host parallelizes independent files and this parser creates no threads.
